name: Dumbbell Lying Single-Arm Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and hold a dumbbell straight above one shoulder, palm inward.
Hold your upper arm still and bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell beside your head.
Extend your elbow fully to press the dumbbell back above your shoulder.
Finish the working arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arm pointed steadily toward the ceiling throughout.
Lower slowly with a neutral wrist and avoid letting your elbow flare outward.
